data.title: Frightful Free-For All: Play for Free until November 1!
data.content:
Try out the Autumn 2024 update and the full War Robots: Frontiers Early Access experience for free from October 17 until November 1 on MY.GAMES Launcher and Steam.

Fall into fun with the new Update, complete with a brand new Battle Pass, new Weapons, new Legendary Pilots, and new Robots.

How To Access On MY.GAMES Launcher

  • Download War Robots: Frontiers and click Play!

How To Access On Steam

  • Head to the War Robots: FrontiersSteam page.
  • Select Request Access under War Robots: Frontiers | Free Trial on the War Robots: Frontiers Steam store page.
  • All players will be automatically accepted to join.

Halloween Events

Celebrate the spooky season during Frightful Free-For-All with the following frightfully good events.

  • Spooky Sticker: Head to the in-game Store to claim the Nanite Nightmare Sticker for 1 Credit from October 17–31.

  • Ghosts of Honor Event: Play matches to earn the Oni Helmet Sticker, Oni Decal, and Oni Renegade Skin from October 17–31.
  • Dev Q&A: Join the developers of War Robots: Frontiers on Discord at 19:00 CEST on Friday, October 18 for a Q&A session.
  • Community Play Session: Join fellow petrified Pilots on October 25 (18:00 CEST) for a special Halloween Play Session! Head to War Robots: Frontiers Discord at the specified time and join the Discord Stage, and stay to the end of the session to receive the Pumpkin Pilot Sticker.

All Halloween items claimed will be retained after the Launch in 2025! 

Subscribe to the official newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on X (Twitter), Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and Reddit, and join the official Discord server.
